propositions: Jira issue KEYs change when moved between projects, but numeric IDs remain immutable; bindings keyed on the mutable KEY silently orphan the binding when the old key stops resolving.
Third-party movers (automations, post-functions) may fail to populate the moved_issue_key table, after which the old key 404s and the binding cannot recover the issue.
The remediation captures the numeric ID alongside the KEY on every binding and, on a 404, retries the lookup by ID and re-keys the binding if the ID resolves to a different current KEY.
Existing jira_key-taking methods and Cloud behavior remain unchanged; the ID capture is additive and does not rewrite the reverse index or require store migration.
A binding with no recorded ID degrades gracefully to pre-fix behavior; the ID fallback is only attempted when the key lookup fails.
